description: submission.rs handle_submission_changes builds its response without the updatedProperties field. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires updatedProperties in every /changes response. handle_mailbox_changes, handle_chat_changes, handle_space_changes, handle_thread_changes, handle_message_changes all include 'updatedProperties': Value::Null. The omission in handle_submission_changes means clients cannot distinguish 'no properties changed' from 'field absent due to server bug'.
title: EmailSubmission/changes missing updatedProperties field
